hypothesis.claim: On the exact canonical opening 1000000 bytes, the original byte-identical CMIX package with only CMIX_PPM_RSS_MB=8192 added in a clean environment reproduces the frozen known payload and archive across matched P, E-A, and E-B arms and exactly decodes enwik9_uncompressed.
hypothesis.falsification: Reject opening-1M identity authority on any source/package closure drift, known payload or archive mismatch, fresh-arm mismatch, inverse failure, strict guard failure, outer-lease verification failure, current-host Geekbench binding failure, or incomplete output manifest. Memory eligibility, runtime eligibility, and PPM trigger eligibility are N/A at this scope and can neither pass nor falsify the mechanism.
